meta.name: story-long-scan
meta.description: 长篇网文扫榜。分析起点、番茄、晋江等平台排行榜数据，提炼市场趋势与热门题材。触发方式：/story-long-scan、/长篇扫榜、「长篇什么火」「起点排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫遍热门小说榜单，快速摸清题材风向
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果准备写长篇网文，想根据平台热度确定题材。
copy.tagline_en: Scan top novel rankings and quickly grasp genre trends
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're starting a long-form web novel and want to pick a genre based on platform trends.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扮演网文市场分析师：按平台采集排行榜数据，提炼题材热度、新题材信号与经典题材动态，输出扫榜报告，并依据报告给出 2-3 个可行选题，写入选题决策.md。
howto.when: 当用户输入 /story-long-scan、/长篇扫榜 或「长篇什么火」等说法时触发。

say.text: 扫一下起点月票榜，归纳最近的热门题材。
say.note: 会采集榜单并输出题材热度分析。

say.text: 番茄男频阅读榜前20里有哪些新题材？
say.note: 按题材逐页采集，提炼新题材信号。

say.text: 结合晋江金榜，给3个可写的女频选题。
say.note: 生成扫榜报告与选题决策.md。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a web-novel market analyst: it collects ranking data from Qidian, Fanqie, and Jinjiang, summarizes genre trends, outputs a scan report, and proposes 2-3 feasible topics in a decision file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user enters /story-long-scan, /长篇扫榜, or asks like '长篇什么火' (what's hot in long-form fiction).

say_en.text: Scan the Qidian monthly ticket ranking and summarize hot genres.
say_en.note: It will collect the list and output a genre heat analysis.

say_en.text: What new genres are in Fanqie's male-channel reading top 20?
say_en.note: It scrapes by category and extracts new-genre signals.

say_en.text: Based on Jinjiang's gold list, suggest 3 female-channel topics.
say_en.note: It produces a scan report and a topic-decision file.
